seo_title: Find STEM Scholarships for International Students USA
seo_description: STEM scholarships for international students in the USA: compare deadlines, award ranges, and eligibility, then apply on official program pages.
intro: Trying to find STEM scholarships in the USA that international students can actually apply for usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and subject tags. This filtered slice brings those programs into one place so you can compare options tied to engineering, health professions, education, and other related fields without losing the international student focus. The rows below are not all the same: award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements can range from lighter-touch applications to entries that may ask for more supporting material. If you are planning your scholarship search for the upcoming cycle, it is worth checking these listings promptly and reading each requirement line closely before you apply.
h1: Find STEM Scholarships for International Students in USA
supporting: Use this list to compare more than just the scholarship title. Look at the field labels, study level, citizenship or residency wording, and any requirement notes shown in each row. Some listings may fit broad STEM interests, while others are narrower or sit alongside education, medicine, community, or miscellaneous categories. Open the official page for any strong match, confirm current terms, and verify award details and deadline language before you spend time on an application.
related_intro: If these results feel too broad or too narrow, related pages can help you refine the search by topic, study level, or applicant type. That is often the fastest way to find USA scholarships that better match your course of study and eligibility profile.

faq.question: How can I find STEM scholarships in the USA for international students on this page?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to compare rows tagged to STEM and international-student eligibility in the USA context. Then open each listing and verify the official eligibility, study level, field of study, and application steps on the source page.

faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed here as an international student?
faq.answer: Not automatically. These programs below are relevant to your search, but eligibility still varies by listing, including citizenship or residency labels, study level, and field such as engineering, education, or health professions.

faq.question: How do I compare award amounts and deadlines across these listings?
faq.answer: Amounts and deadlines differ by program, so compare each row individually before you apply. Some listings show dollar values, but not every row does, and all final details should be confirmed on the official scholarship page.

faq.question: Do these USA STEM scholarships all require essays?
faq.answer: No single rule applies across this catalog slice. Some listings appear to have essay requirements and some may be lighter-touch, so check each scholarship's requirements before you apply.
